title: Best by Broan — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Best by Broan.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Best in Ventilation." Specialty tier. Best by Broan is the premium ventilation line from Broan-NuTone. Stronger motors, lower noise levels, and better design than standard Broan hoods. Available in chimney, under-cabinet, and island configurations.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Premium ventilation needs above standard Broan. Kitchen remodels wanting better performance.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Best by Broan:

• Premium performance within the Broan family

• Lower noise levels than standard Broan models

• Better design options including chimney and island

• Broan parts and service network backing

• Step-up from builder-grade without going to Zephyr pricing
